title: D-18 resolver build + F2+x rerun (before and after rows)
outcome: F2+x conflicts resolved auditably; every resolution traceable and reversible
acceptance: Each resolution is a recorded signed decision; verify passes and fails on a forged/altered resolution; undo restores the pre-resolution state and is itself recorded
Bench F2+x reported before and after side by side; hero F2+ unchanged
summary: Built ADR-05a (rev 3 refused_agents by maya). Bench F2+x 20 seeds H=6 T=40 (BENCH-S3 S4-13 table, native macOS): resolver off -> on: R 1/5 [0..1/5] -> 0 [0..0]; C 21/254 -> 0; held honest 29 [0..35] -> 3 [0..7]; unholds 3 -> 5 (2 tainted re-held). 19/20 seeds resolved (s7 has no conflict); ks verify OK on all 20 (no resolution_invalid). Hero F2+ seeds 1-5: score.json identical resolver off vs on. Resolver-off path does not change hero (plan bytes, score identical; native hero C 0/265 on s2).
review: [kabir · done] PASS. Container rerun (killswitch:kabir, per_agent_uid; ks bench --seeds 1-20 --faults F2+x --hold 6 --baselines system --ticks 40 --resolver-faults F2+x): same table cell for cell as native. Resolver off->on: R 1/5 [0..1/5] -> 0 [0..0]; C 21/254 [0..44/243] -> 0; held honest 29 [0..35] -> 3 [0..7]; unholds 3 -> 5 (2 tainted re-held). 19/20 resolved (s7 no ww conflict). Separate container pass: verify OK + per_agent_uid on all 40 runs (off and on), no resolution_invalid. Hero F2+ s1-5 off vs on: score (minus resolver keys) and plan bytes identical, verify OK. BENCH-S3 S4-13 provenance text now names the container run (raw runs/bench-s4-13-ctr/). Attacks: culprit-write-never-survives property re-run over seeds 1-20 (in-process world, scratch, not committed): all pass, every resolved object == S*, rebased agent never the suspect. candidates[1] with seed writes refused, suspect choice/evidence writer refused, forged rule / altered rebased_hash / claimed field / replayed / out-of-order / resolve-after-undo / double undo -> resolution_invalid, gateway skipping the hash check -> TAMPER, unresolve round trip restores versions and re-holds exactly, 1.3-1.6 fixtures verify, resolver off plan bytes identical: all covered by tests and green. Suites: native 1137 passed 14 skipped; container 1149 passed 2 skipped; make smoke OK (anchored); make demo OK (anchored, per_agent_uid, R 0/9 C 0/265). Non-blocking nit: verify resolution_pass and runtime _alerts silently skip an alert whose side entry is unreadable (fail-open on refused_agents); side_pass already fails such a run (alerts never redactable), so no hole today, but make resolution_pass fail closed (resolution_invalid) post-freeze. Residual (ADR-05a 2a, THREAT-MODEL C3) stated correctly: a non-root colluder with no taint-origin write can have its own args rebased.
